main_moments_nav.description: Left navigation aperture icon. Opens the Moments window.

moments_camera.description: Camera icon in the top-left toolbar of the Moments window. Opens the Windows file picker.

moments_close.description: Close button in the top-right area of the Moments window.

observations: WeChat 4.1.10.53 exposes only the top-level window through UI Automation; no actionable child controls were exposed in the tested states.
The main Weixin window and the Moments window use different bounding rectangles after Moments opens.
Win32 GetWindowRect did not match screenshot coordinates under the current display scaling. Use UI Automation BoundingRectangle for coordinate clicks.
Clicking moments_camera opened the Windows file picker. The final publish action has not been automated.
